answer.intent: Stack box_large, then box_medium, then box_small into a tower centred within 1 cm per level on the right half of the table (y < 0) near the robot. Put the apple, can and cup on the left half (y > 0), all upright and not interpenetrating.
assumptions: No body represents the robot base, so 'within 70 cm of the robot base' cannot be stated directly. It is only approximated by placing the bottom box at (0.45, -0.35), which is about 0.57 m from the base. This is a soft pull, so the 70 cm limit is not guaranteed.

'Entirely at y < 0' is expressed by keeping box_large's centre at least 0.223 m to the right of the table centre (y = 0). 0.223 m is half the diagonal of the box's 0.31 x 0.32 m footprint, so the box stays clear of y = 0 at any heading.

'Entirely at y > 0' is expressed with centre gaps from the table centre: about 0.05 m for the apple and can, and 0.06 m for the cup. These are slightly more than each object's half-width, but the margin is thin if an object turns.
